splits: Assign entire publisher groups to dev or test before model development; document families, versions, near-duplicate components and derivations stay together. Previously exposed 47 dev/37 test questions and all 218 old extracted FAQs are historical/regression only, not new holdout candidates.
source_requirements: Official public sources with recorded access/reuse terms; restrictions checked before bulk acquisition
Explicit jurisdiction, insurance type, publisher, URL, acquisition time, body SHA256 and document-group identity
Exclude access-restricted sites, personal submissions, third-party material without suitable permission, obsolete provisions without explicit as-of framing
Do not infer unrestricted reuse from public availability or government domain
per_item_requirements: Unique substantive information need; no paraphrase/template multiplication
Source-original FAQ or explicitly agent-authored, with provenance distinguished
Verifiable reference answer and exact evidence span offsets/hashes
Question can be understood without omitted FAQ/page context; resolve pronouns and jurisdiction
Calculation has cited rule, all operands, units, formula, exact independently checked result and rounding rule
Multi-evidence requires each cited span; redundant citations do not qualify
Refusal records realistic missing facts and why accessible evidence cannot settle the specific request; no empty-context-only shortcut
Automated checks passed; unresolved quality findings excluded from accepted count

Numerical QA must require retrieval of an identified source rule/rate/threshold omitted from the question; supplying all rules and operands is arithmetic-only and held. Record explicit content-review necessity rationale.

deduplication.exact: Normalize Unicode/whitespace/case; cluster question, answer and evidence duplicates
deduplication.near: Question and evidence char ngram similarity plus lexical semantic candidate screening; threshold flags require disposition, not silent acceptance
deduplication.history: Compare all candidate questions/evidence against accessible training/dev/test/report strings and old 218 FAQs, preserve known denied-path exclusions and audit hashes
deduplication.pretraining: Foundation-model pretraining contamination cannot be completely excluded

content_review.reviewer_type: Codex agent content review, not human/expert review
content_review.required: 100% numeric/multi-evidence/refusal, at least 25% ordinary QA; stratify by publisher, insurance type and document group
content_review.records: Item-specific decisions, error taxonomy, evidence rationale, revisions and removals retained; automated checks and model review separately counted
content_review.escalation: Any critical sampled error triggers full review of affected publisher/extractor/task stratum; accepted items with outstanding defects forbidden

freeze: Only after at least 1000 accepted test records and all quality gates pass; hash corpus, test/dev manifests, review ledger, exclusion ledger and evaluation configuration before model inference
evaluation: Frozen baseline, no post-test tuning; separate independent dev for any iteration; fixed denominators including errors/refusals, retrieval Recall/Hit separately, evidence completeness, numeric result accuracy, citation support and refusal/coverage. Report per task/publisher counts and Wilson or publisher/document-cluster intervals as appropriate.
publication: Code, synthetic unit tests, provenance and aggregate audit records may be pushed. Raw sources and derived question/evidence text stay local unless each applicable source license explicitly permits redistribution; never publish private data or weights.
estimate: Revised2026-10-04: earlier12-24h is not supported by observed quality-review yield. Roughly50-70hours additional construction/review may be needed at current cumulative yield, excluding final inference; new-source acquisition and expanded containment/family review may extend this. This is not a completion deadline. No completion claim based on unreviewed candidates.

task_scope: Consumer insurance coverage, benefits, policy cost, claims, purchaser requirements and specific policy-related recourse. Exclude standalone professional licensing/continuing education, corporate regulatory administration, representative compensation applications and project/grant milestones without a consumer policy/benefit/claim need. Applies to TEST and DEV; codifies stage19/stage43 scope decisions, not a relaxation.
